claim_boundary: This verifies that the triplet-training implementation executes end to end on a public fixture.
The MRR values are from only 10 held-out questions and have no zero-shot or random/lexical negative control in this receipt.
They are not comparable to the paper's internal 4,250-query test or evidence of enterprise lift.
next_gate: Run at least three seeds with fixed random, lexical, single-model, and composite negative arms, plus audited false-negative labels and zero-shot reranker baselines.
